summary: Script implements label-assignment logic cleanly with good bash practices (set -euo pipefail, local vars, error handler). Workflow YAML follows conventions (pinned actions, least-privilege perms, matrix strategy). However, critical task requirements are unmet: (1) bats-core tests entirely missing—task mandates TDD methodology with failing tests FIRST; (2) fixture files referenced in workflow (docs-only.files, api-tests.files, etc.) and label-rules.conf are not provided; (3) workflow lacks test validation logic to parse output and assert exact expected values (task requirement); (4) act-result.txt missing (explicitly required artifact); (5) no actionlint validation step shown. Script is maintainable in isolation but workflow is fragile—references nonexistent files without creating them. Deliverable is incomplete and non-functional as shipped.
